The World Bank defines internet users as individuals who have used the internet from any location in the last three months, via any device including mobile phones, tablets, personal computers, and gaming consoles.

faq.q: How often is this data updated?
faq.a: The World Bank publishes updated estimates annually. This page is rebuilt from the latest release, retrieved {{retrievedAtHuman}}.

methodology: Figures are individuals using the internet as a percentage of population, as published in the {{sourceLink}} (indicator IT.NET.USER.ZS), retrieved {{retrievedAtHuman}}. Rankings are computed among all countries with reported data for each year; countries with no reported value in a given year are excluded from that year's ranking. Trajectory sparklines index each country's series to its own {{firstYear}}–{{latestYear}} range and are not comparable in level across rows.
